context: Ryosuke shares life examples with Kenji about handling stress.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 健次さん、例を、話します。
lines.en: Kenji-san, let me tell you something.
lines.style: Warm, generous opening. Slow, deliberate pacing—this is shared with care. Soft eye contact. The tone of a father who has something worth saying and trusts you'll listen.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Quiet attentiveness. Leans in slightly. No rushing. The respect of someone honored to be trusted with this moment.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.en: I was lost too, when I was younger.
lines.style: Gentle vulnerability. A small pause before continuing—allowing the admission to land. Warm, not heavy. The tone of someone who has made peace with his own past.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: How did you find your way through it?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, not performance. Soft forward lean. The question itself is tender—not probing, but truly wanting to understand.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.en: Time and perspective. You have to look at life in the long view.
lines.style: Measured and philosophical. Each phrase given space to breathe. Conviction without heaviness. The voice of someone speaking from lived experience.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Sincere appreciation. A small exhale of recognition. Not flattering—genuinely moved by what he's heard.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.style: Warm close. A hand extended—not a lecture ending, but an invitation. Soft, steady, full of quiet promise. The voice of someone who will be there for this.
